subject: Re: Permitted use inquiry - 3800 S Charles Blvd (CG)
body: Used motor vehicle sales at 3800 S Charles Blvd is permitted in the CG district per Greenville Code sec. 9-4-78 Table 1. The conditional note in the online table applies only to parcels abutting residential zoning, which this parcel does not. No special use permit is required.
